about: Directory search evaluation set (SRI-86). Each case is a real intent: the owner's question that missed Drip, find_paid_service queries hosted agents made in production (generalised where they named a person or a private task), and the ticket's own examples. `expected` lists the CrowdCode-listed services a person who knows the directory would want in the top 3; any of them counts as a hit. Scored by scripts/search_eval.py: recall@3 = share of min(3, |expected|) found in the top 3, and MRR of the first expected service. `also` (SRI-115 W10, 2026-11-17): once search ranked the whole services index (~13k offerings, not ~400 listings), other offerings answer the same intents. An independent judge labelled every result the old live search or the index search put in its top 5 (five seeds, plus the top 5 by match alone) that was not already expected; those it found answer the intent as well as the expected ones are listed in `also`, and every verdict with its reason is in judged.json. Cases with `source: index` were added for the index (video, speech, image editing and other model-backed capabilities).
